summary.description: One or two sentences: what you checked and how. In a refuter run: why the finding holds or does not.

severity.description: blocking: must not merge as it is. advisory: worth fixing, safe to merge. parked: a real problem this change did not cause.

line.description: Line in the file as it is after the change. Leave out when the problem is something missing.

claim.description: One or two sentences: what is wrong, and the input or sequence that shows it.

check.description: A deterministic check that would catch this kind of mistake, when one exists.

output.description: Its output, trimmed to the lines that show the problem.

repeats.description: On a re-review only: the id of the earlier finding this one repeats, such as F2.
